    "System outages and malfunctions can impact uptime and accessibility."

  "overall_experience": "This Customer Service Officer likely found LiveAgent to be a generally effective and cost-efficient platform for managing customer interactions across various channels over their two-plus years of use. Despite these drawbacks, the platform's overall value and utility for their role in real estate likely led to a moderately positive experience."
